documented_outage_options.label: Can't enter station
documented_outage_options.text: Take the ramp at the southwest corner of Ashby and Adeline Streets to access the other side of the station via the lower BART parking lot, or use the elevator inside of Ed Roberts Campus (only during opening hours).

documented_outage_options.label: Can't exit station
documented_outage_options.text: Go back into the station and exit on the other (lower) side. Then take the ramp at the southwest corner of Ashby and Adeline Streets to get back up to street level, or use the elevator inside of Ed Roberts Campus (only during opening hours).
